name: XPRS 1.3.1
body:
## XPRS 1.3.1

### Five languages
- The app, its settings and every bundled wapp (Chat, Circles, Forum, Mail, Maps, Mesh, Status, Wapp Store) now speak **English, Portuguese, Spanish, German and French**.
- Dates, times and schedules follow the chosen language.

### Several callsigns under one base
- Your X1 base callsign (for example X1ABCD) stays fixed and names your folder.
- Up to **four issued callsigns** sit under it; one is active at a time.
- A conversation keeps the callsign it was started with, so switching callsigns does not mix threads.
- The callsign field types normally again.

### Reach a station from anywhere (APRS-IS-like, no central server)
- A phone that hears a station on Bluetooth or the LAN reports it, signed, to its archivers over Reticulum.
- An archiver holding mail for that station forwards it to **every** phone or station that currently hears it, once each, and again when a new one reports. One delivery receipt releases all the copies.
- Receipts and files now travel on the radio lane as well as messages.
- Opening a station's conversation fetches its archived messages from the archivers automatically, following one redirect. You never pick a route.
- New diagnostics on the local API: `forwarder`, `hearsReports` and `fetch` in `/api/status`, and `POST /api/xprs/fetch`.

### Fixes
- **Bluetooth 5**: a phone where Bluetooth was switched on after the app no longer stays a scan-only leaf for the whole session.
- **Bridges**: Meshtastic and MeshCore messages keep their own timestamps.
- **Chat**: a bridged sender wears its network tag (Meshtastic, MeshCore), and message Info shows the relay path.

### Specification
- XPRS.md 12.8.1 and 12.12 describe the multi-gateway return leg; section 37 is brought up to date.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/xprs-dev/app/compare/v1.2.28...v1.3.1

_1.3.0 was tagged but never published: its builds failed on a lock file resolved with an older Flutter, and on the new ubuntu-26.04 runner. 1.3.1 is the same release with both fixed._
